players.product: Enhanced geothermal (EGS) 24/7 baseload power from modular GeoBlocks (Cape Station geocluster, Utah) under long-term PPAs with hyperscalers, utilities and industrial buyers, grid-connected and behind-the-meter

quarterly_data.signal: Fervo's IPO prospectus financial statements: revenues of $138 thousand in the year ended December 31, 2025 versus $199 thousand in 2024; capital expenditures of $465,659 thousand in 2025 versus $178,693 thousand in 2024; construction-in-process of $789,571 thousand at December 31, 2025 versus $258,900 thousand a year earlier. The prospectus says its growth depends on electricity demand driven by AI data center development; no customer is named in its concentration disclosure.
